name: GitLab Pages

evidence.static: 03: managed static website hosting; repository changes are built and published with GitLab CI/CD

line: Build and publish static websites from GitLab repositories.

free.text: Free plan includes 400 CI compute minutes per namespace monthly

work.math: 100 build minutes fit within 400 a month. 100 MB fits the 1 GB site limit. No 100 GB traffic allowance or overage price was found.
Pages only hosts static sites and does not run an API.
Pages has no app runtime or managed PostgreSQL service.
